rules.C: C(arm) = median over cells of dM_main - dM_round
rules.S: S(arm) = #cells where the donor-new-source patch is JOINT and the donor-ROUND-source patch of the same arm is not (target host new)
rules.SPEC: SPEC iff dM_main > dM_round in >= 75% of cells AND in a majority of cells for >= 10 of 14 donor groups
rules.SUF: SUF(arm) iff S(arm) >= 1/2 S(full) and SPEC(arm)
rules.ab_verdicts: AB = span positions 0-12. SHIFT_AB_SUFFICES iff SUF(sh_fAB) else SHIFT_AB_INSUFFICIENT; SHIFT_AB_C29_SUFFICES iff SUF(sh_fAB_c29) else SHIFT_AB_C29_INSUFFICIENT; SHIFT_AB_S05_SUFFICES iff SUF(sh_fAB_s05) else SHIFT_AB_S05_INSUFFICIENT; SHIFT_AB_NEEDED iff not SUF(sh_xAB) else SHIFT_AB_NOT_NEEDED; AB_LOCATION_SPECIFIC iff SUF(sh_fAB), neither sh_fKR nor sh_fRR is SUF and S(sh_fAB) > max(S(sh_fKR), S(sh_fRR)); AB_LOCATION_NOT_SPECIFIC iff SUF(sh_fAB) and sh_fKR or sh_fRR is SUF; else AB_LOCATION_UNRESOLVED. AB_BY_HOST:<host8>=<S(sh_fAB)>/<S(cs1)>,... over the responsive hosts
rules.always_reported: S, SPEC, J_main, J_round, median dM and C per arm; per host; leave-one-donor-group-out of every verdict; energy shares, remainder shares, tilt errors; the S of each null, pooled and per host; change norm of every arm relative to full
rules.consistency_gate: full = the M3 all-heads patch: its 208 rows equal M3's bitwise and S(full) = 51; meanD_host = the M6 pooled-donor arm: its 208 rows equal M6's bitwise and S = 39 (GPU, checked in the run); cs1 / cs_s05 / cs_s025 / cpar16_sm / sh_fBLOCK / sh_xAUTH / sh_xBLOCK = the M12 arms (same patch fields): their 7 x 208 rows equal M12's bitwise and S = 39 / 38 / 13 / 27 / 18 / 26 / 20; otherwise every verdict is INCONSISTENT_WITH_M3_M6_M12 and no claim
rules.interpretation_fixed_in_advance: SHIFT_AB_SUFFICES with AB_LOCATION_SPECIFIC: the common shift's role sits at the author and block lines of the appended item; with SHIFT_AB_C29_SUFFICES the repair needs only that shift and c at the round value. REM_OPPOSES with REM_DIRECTION_SPECIFIC: tilting c towards the common subspace works against the round-specific repair beyond a random tilt of the same size, which locates M12's SUBSPACE_BELOW_COSINE in the in-subspace remainder r; REM_OPPOSES with REM_DIRECTION_NOT_SPECIFIC: any orthogonal push of that size does the same, so r is not special. All M13 arms except full are pooled-donor arms (effectively 8 host replicates, 3 responding in M9-M12); per-host S is the honest unit; a host at its ceiling or floor for an arm and all its nulls reads AT
rules.readouts: M = conflict margin; A = logit(reject_conflict) - max(accept, wait); JOINT = M > 0 and A > 0; dM = M(patch) - M(in-run capture of host new)
rules.responsive_host: a host where S(cs1) on its cells exceeds half its cells
rules.size_gate: cpar16_sm has ||c|| per row and position within 1e-3 relative where not capped (fail-closed, as M9-M12); every tilt arm and null keeps c's component along c and has tilt norm |lam| ||r|| within 1e-6 relative to ||c|| (fail-closed); sh_fAB_c29 sets c_30 to 0 exactly
rules.tilt_null_verdicts: rnull_<s>_<i> = c + q with q orthogonal to c, ||q|| = ||r|| per row and position, its direction drawn at random (seed per cell and i, the same at both s and for main and round). Per responsive host and s in 1/2, 3/8, with the host S of the 5 nulls N: add = the host S of rem_p1 at s: HARM_BEYOND_NULL iff add < min N, LESS_HARM_THAN_NULL iff add > max N, else AT; remove = the host S of rem_m1 at s: REMOVAL_BEYOND_NULL iff remove > max N, REMOVAL_BELOW_NULL iff remove < min N, else AT. REM_NULL_BY_HOST:<host8>=s05:<add>/<remove>,s0375:<add>/<remove>,...; pooled: REM_DIRECTION_SPECIFIC iff some HARM_BEYOND_NULL or REMOVAL_BEYOND_NULL and no LESS_HARM_THAN_NULL or REMOVAL_BELOW_NULL; REM_DIRECTION_NOT_SPECIFIC iff all AT; REM_DIRECTION_REVERSED iff some LESS_HARM_THAN_NULL or REMOVAL_BELOW_NULL and no BEYOND; else REM_DIRECTION_MIXED
rules.tilt_verdicts: r = P c - (P c . c^) c^ per question row and span position (P = projector on the first 16 right singular vectors of the cell's same-arm pairs basis, as cpar16_sm); arm rem_<lam> = c + lam r, main -s/2, round +s/2. Per s in 1, 1/2, 3/8 with S_m = S(rem_m1..), S_0 = S(cs1 / cs_s05 / cs_s0375), S_p = S(rem_p1..): TILT_OPPOSES iff S_m >= S_0 >= S_p and S_m > S_p; TILT_SUPPORTS iff S_m <= S_0 <= S_p and S_m < S_p; TILT_NO_EFFECT iff S_m = S_0 = S_p; TILT_MIXED otherwise. Pooled: REM_OPPOSES iff some s is TILT_OPPOSES and every s is TILT_OPPOSES or TILT_NO_EFFECT; REM_SUPPORTS likewise; REM_NO_EFFECT iff all TILT_NO_EFFECT; else REM_MIXED. S and C of rem_p2 and rem_p2_s05 are reported
rules.units: the 104 cross-group cells of M1-M6; cells share donors and hosts, and the pooled-mean arms vary with the donor only through the pool exclusion (effectively 8 hosts), so counts are descriptive decision rules, not independent tests; per-host S is always reported
